p.src: 1  Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

en: Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
u.src: 1  Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

p.src: 2  Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Worship the LORD in holy array.

en: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Worship the LORD in holy array.
u.src: 2  Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Worship the LORD in holy array.

p.src: 3  The LORD’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even the LORD on many waters.

en: The LORD’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even the LORD on many waters.
u.src: 3  The LORD’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even the LORD on many waters.

p.src: 4  The LORD’s voice is powerful. The LORD’s voice is full of majesty.

en: The LORD’s voice is powerful. The LORD’s voice is full of majesty.
u.src: 4  The LORD’s voice is powerful. The LORD’s voice is full of majesty.

p.src: 5  The LORD’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

en: The LORD’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
u.src: 5  The LORD’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

p.src: 6  He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.

en: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.
u.src: 6  He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.

p.src: 7  The LORD’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.

en: The LORD’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.
u.src: 7  The LORD’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.

p.src: 8  The LORD’s voice shakes the wilderness. The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

en: The LORD’s voice shakes the wilderness. The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
u.src: 8  The LORD’s voice shakes the wilderness. The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

p.src: 9  The LORD’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”

en: The LORD’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”
u.src: 9  The LORD’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”

p.src: 10  The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, the LORD sits as King forever.

en: The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, the LORD sits as King forever.
u.src: 10  The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, the LORD sits as King forever.

p.src: 11  The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.

en: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.
u.src: 11  The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.
